title: 第6章 立威，都是为了弟弟啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“滴答~滴答~”

血点子落在地上发出声响。

“你……你敢打我？”下意识捂着头的谢宏踉踉跄跄稳住了身体，看了眼手上的血液后彻底失控，拔出枪大吼道：“草！老子他妈毙了你！”

许景川抬起一脚踹过去。

谢宏跌跌撞撞的摔倒在地。

枪也脱手飞了出去。

许景川伸手接住枪，在谢宏刚爬起来的瞬间用枪口抵住他的额头寒声说道：“以下犯上对长官不敬，还企图枪杀长官，信不信我毙了你。”

办公室里静得落针可闻。

所有人都傻了。

“许队，可千万别冲动啊。”胡天最先反应过来，神色紧张的劝说。

“对对对，不至于，真不至于。”

“许队长，谢副队肯定不是有意冒犯你的，咱们先放下枪再说吧。”

其他人也纷纷好言相劝。

感受着额头上冰冷的枪口，谢宏手脚发凉，为了面子，他本想梗着脖子嘲讽许景川不敢开枪。

可当对上那双平静到似乎漠视一切的眼睛后，又把话咽了回去。

万一呢？

俗话说得好，羞刀难入鞘啊！

一时间他僵住了，进退两难。

“谢副队，你给许队道个歉吧。”

“是啊是啊，一家人，没必要搞到动枪的地步，闹大了都不好。”

“许队，对……对不住。”听见这种话，谢宏心里松了口气，强忍着愤怒和憋屈顺着大家给的台阶下了。

许景川把枪拍到他怀里，“没有下一次，自己去医务室包扎一下。”

他和谢宏有根本利益冲突，所以谢宏和周川无论如何都会对付他。

既然如此，还不如趁谢宏主动挑事这个机会踩着他立威。

至少能借此先在队内站稳脚跟。

第一印象很重要。

所有下属都看着呢。

自己刚刚要是退缩了的话，再想挽回形象可就难了，一个软弱的领导不值得下属站队、下属也不敢追随。

谢宏接住枪，有些狼狈的捂着额头走了，眼底满是怒火和怨毒。

好汉不吃眼前亏。

此仇不报，他誓不为人！

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Tick tock~tick tock~"

Blood drops made a sound as they fell to the ground.

"You...you dare to hit me?" Xie Hong, who subconsciously covered his head, stumbled and stabilized his body. After looking at the blood on his hand, he completely lost control. He pulled out his gun and shouted: "Fuck! I'll fucking kill you!"

Xu Jingchuan raised his foot and kicked him over.

Xie Hong stumbled and fell to the ground.

The gun also flew away.

Xu Jingchuan reached out to catch the gun. The moment Xie Hong got up, he put the muzzle of the gun against his forehead and said in a cold voice: "The following is disrespectful to the officer and attempts to shoot the officer. Believe it or not, I will kill you."

The office was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.

Everyone was dumbfounded.

"Captain Xu, please don't be impulsive." Hu Tian was the first to react and persuaded nervously.

"Yes, yes, it won't happen. It really won't happen."

"Captain Xu, Deputy Captain Xie definitely didn't mean to offend you. Let's put down the gun first and then talk."

Others also offered kind words and advice.

Feeling the cold muzzle of the gun on his forehead, Xie Hong's hands and feet felt cold. For the sake of face, he wanted to taunt Xu Jingchuan for not daring to shoot.

But when he met those eyes that were so calm and seemed to be indifferent to everything, he swallowed his words again.

What if?

As the saying goes, it's hard to sheath a knife if you're ashamed!

For a moment he froze, in a dilemma.

"Deputy Captain Xie, please apologize to Captain Xu."

"Yes, yes, we are a family. There is no need to go to the point of using guns. It will not be good if it makes a big fuss."

"Captain Xu, I'm sorry." Hearing these words, Xie Hong breathed a sigh of relief and walked down the steps given by everyone while holding back his anger and frustration.

Xu Jingchuan put the gun into his arms and said, "Next time, go to the infirmary and get bandaged."

He and Xie Hong have a fundamental conflict of interest, so Xie Hong and Zhou Chuan will deal with him no matter what.

In this case, it is better to take advantage of Xie Hong's initiative to stir up trouble and step on him to establish his authority.

At least you can use this to gain a foothold in the team first.

First impressions are important.

All the subordinates are watching.

If he had backed down just now, it would be difficult to restore his image. A weak leader is not worthy of his subordinates' support, and his subordinates would not dare to follow him.

Xie Hong caught the gun, covered his forehead in some embarrassment and walked away, his eyes full of anger and resentment.

A good man does not suffer immediate losses.

If this revenge is not avenged, he swears that he will not be a human being!
